title: P-4 probe A: every field filled
body_html:
Outcome

sf issue lint reports a missing section by its heading text. The message names the form field the operator has to fill.

Spec refs

WI-1, SPEC.md section 6.4

Context

Likely involved:

  • crates/factory-core/src/issue.rs
  • crates/factory-cli/src/main.rs
    • the lint subcommand only

Background: https://example.com/design-note

error: section "Stop conditions" is empty

Acceptance criteria

  • AC-1 (test): WHEN a required section is missing THE SYSTEM SHALL name its heading in the lint output.
  • AC-2 (review): WHEN every section is present THE SYSTEM SHALL print nothing and exit 0.

Out of scope

  1. The dispatcher.
  2. The status comment.

Stop conditions

  • The headings of the form changed on GitHub's side.
  • A section appears twice.

body:
### Outcome

`sf issue lint` reports a missing section by its heading text. The message names the form field the operator has to fill.

### Spec refs

WI-1, SPEC.md section 6.4

### Context

Likely involved:

- `crates/factory-core/src/issue.rs`
- `crates/factory-cli/src/main.rs`
  - the `lint` subcommand only

Background: https://example.com/design-note

```text
error: section "Stop conditions" is empty
```

### Acceptance criteria

- AC-1 (test): WHEN a required section is missing THE SYSTEM SHALL name its heading in the lint output.
- AC-2 (review): WHEN every section is present THE SYSTEM SHALL print nothing and exit 0.

### Out of scope

1. The dispatcher.
2. The status comment.

### Stop conditions

* The headings of the form changed on GitHub's side.
* A section appears twice.
